status: Retrospective research: all historical seasons have already been inspected. Future prospective forecasts provide the next untouched test.
distributionFit: Conditional logistic margin scale selected by earlier out-of-sample margin density loss on 4..15 in 0.25 steps; location=scale*logit(p). This was revised after the first retrospective interval-coverage audit showed narrow ranges. All test seasons remain reused research, not untouched validation.
promotionGate: Brier and log loss improve against the previous baseline on paired games; paired day-cluster bootstrap 95% upper Brier difference is below zero; latest-season log loss does not worsen. Otherwise retain as research.
travelLimitation: Road-trip and previous-away sequence are proxies. No geographic distance or time-zone travel data is present.
playerLeaguePrior: Frozen at each season start from earlier eligible appearances, matching the deployed fitted-prior approach.
playerEvaluation: Conditional on an observed appearance; not pregame roster availability or bookmaker prop accuracy. Settings chosen only on earlier seasons.
